Nutrition Assessment
Malnutrition is very common in patients with CKD, especially 
those who are on dialysis. Evidence suggests that the prevalence 
of protein-energy malnutrition (PEM) ranges from approximate-
ly 20% to 70% among adult dialysis patients. Signs and symptoms
of malnutrition present themselves when the GFR declines to 
30 mL/minute, and may progress to signiﬁ cant malnutrition at a
